description.en:
Basic Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, consume STA to deal Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form and in mid-air, press Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

While in Answering Form and in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, continuously consuming STA and dealing Electro DMG to the target.
Depleting all STA or switching to another Resonator ends the skill action early.

Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

When the Normal Attack button is released during Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, Hsin casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, transforming into the Moon Fox upon landing and dealing Electro DMG.
After casting Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 generates a Modular Heartlock at the target's position. Casting Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form causes the Modular Heartlock to collapse, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting this skill consumes STA when Hsin is in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form, consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3.

Upward Cut - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and on the ground, press Jump to cast this skill, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is in mid-air, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form and in the Mechanism Dominion state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form and in the Mechanism Dominion state, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Answering Form

Saat dalam Answering Form, melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form

Saat dalam Answering Form, mengonsumsi STA untuk memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 2.

Mid-air Attack - Answering Form

Saat dalam Answering Form dan di udara, tekan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Plunging Attack dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

Saat dalam Answering Form dan di udara, tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, terus mengonsumsi STA dan memberikan Electro DMG kepada target.
STA yang habis atau berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri aksi skill lebih awal.

Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

Saat tombol Normal Attack dilepas selama Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, Hsin melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, berubah menjadi Moon Fox saat mendarat dan memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Answering Form

Saat dalam Answering Form, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 3.

Basic Attack - Illumining Form

Saat dalam Illumining Form dan tidak dalam state Mechanism Dominion, memerintahkan Xuanfang Mechanisms untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.
Melancarkan Basic Attack - Illumining Form Tahap 1 menghasilkan Modular Heartlock di posisi target. Melancarkan Basic Attack - Illumining Form Tahap 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, atau Resonance Skill - Illumining Form membuat Modular Heartlock runtuh, memberikan Electro DMG.
Melancarkan skill ini mengonsumsi STA saat Hsin berada di udara.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form

Saat dalam Illumining Form, mengonsumsi STA untuk memerintahkan Xuanfang Mechanisms, memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Illumining Form Tahap 3.

Upward Cut - Illumining Form

Saat dalam Illumining Form dan di tanah, tekan Jump untuk melancarkan skill ini, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form

Saat dalam Illumining Form dan Hsin berada di udara, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form digantikan oleh Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.
Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Illumining Form

Saat dalam Illumining Form, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Illumining Form Tahap 3.

Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

Saat dalam Illumining Form dan dalam state Mechanism Dominion, memerintahkan Xuanfang Mechanisms untuk melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

Saat dalam Illumining Form dan dalam state Mechanism Dominion, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Tahap 3.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4.
Can be cast in mid-air.

If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, she turns into the Moon Fox.
- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin gains Dustless Tread. With Dustless Tread, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. Dustless Tread is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the Moon Fox form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin restores 6% of Max HP every 3s.
- Taking damage, failing to perform a Dodge with directional input while on the ground, or Dodging in mid-air will end the Moon Fox form. Switching to another Resonator or pressing Resonance Skill also ends the Moon Fox form. Press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4, which also ends the Moon Fox form.
- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.
- Resonance Liberation is disabled when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Answering Form

Saat dalam Answering Form, tekan Resonance Skill untuk memberikan Electro DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 4.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Jika Hsin bergerak di tanah dalam waktu singkat setelah melancarkan skill ini, ia berubah menjadi Moon Fox.
- Saat dalam wujud Moon Fox dan di luar pertempuran, Hsin mendapat Dustless Tread. Dengan Dustless Tread, Hsin dapat memasuki jangkauan aggro target tanpa memicu pertempuran. Dustless Tread dihapus saat Hsin memasuki pertempuran, diganti keluar, atau mengakhiri wujud Moon Fox dengan interaksi lingkungan, gameplay, atau fitur.
- Saat dalam wujud Moon Fox dan di luar pertempuran, Hsin memulihkan 6% Max HP setiap 3 dtk.
- Menerima damage, gagal melakukan Dodge dengan input arah di tanah, atau melakukan Dodge di udara akan mengakhiri wujud Moon Fox. Berganti ke Resonator lain atau menekan Resonance Skill juga mengakhiri wujud Moon Fox. Tekan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 4, yang juga mengakhiri wujud Moon Fox.
- State Dash terus mengonsumsi STA saat Hsin dalam wujud Moon Fox.
- Resonance Liberation dinonaktifkan saat Hsin dalam wujud Moon Fox.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form

Saat dalam Illumining Form dan Hsin berada di tanah, tekan Resonance Skill agar Hsin memerintahkan Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Formshift

Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector unlocks Formshift.
Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.

Pillars Across Heaven

After casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, when in Illumining Form with full Resonance Energy, Pillars Across Heaven becomes available.
Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.

Edict

Casting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG.
- Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.

Heart Manifest

Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.
While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.
Besides, if Hsin is still in Illumining Form after exiting Heart Manifest, and Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering.

Invoked Form: Answering

Hsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

Invoked Form: Illumining

Hsin turns back into Illumining Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Upward Cut - Illumining Form; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.
description.id:
Formshift

Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer atau Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector membuka Formshift.
Lancarkan Formshift untuk membentangkan Manifold Sanctum. Hsin berganti ke Illumining Form, membuka rangkaian kemampuan tempur baru, dan memasuki state Heart Manifest.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara saat dekat dengan tanah.
Saat dalam Illumining Form, terlibat dalam dialog quest, melakukan interaksi lingkungan dengan animasi, atau menggunakan Utility akan mengembalikan Hsin ke Answering Form untuk melakukan aksi yang sesuai.
Saat dalam Illumining Form, Hsin dapat berjalan di permukaan air, dan akan terus mengonsumsi STA di area air dalam. Dalam Walking Mode, Hsin dalam Illumining Form dapat melangkah dari tebing ke udara dan berjalan perlahan di udara, terus mengonsumsi STA dalam state ini. Hsin tidak dapat memulihkan STA saat dalam Illumining Form dan di udara.

Pillars Across Heaven

Setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons atau Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, saat dalam Illumining Form dengan Resonance Energy penuh, Pillars Across Heaven tersedia.
Lancarkan Pillars Across Heaven untuk menjatuhkan Manifold Sanctum, memberikan Electro DMG kepada target, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara saat dekat dengan tanah.
Hsin kembali ke Answering Form dan keluar dari state Heart Manifest.

Edict

Melancarkan Formshift memberikan Hsin 21 stack Edict selama 45 dtk. Efek ini tidak dapat melebihi 21 stack dan semua stack dihapus saat durasi berakhir.
Setelah Resonator di lapangan memberikan DMG, Hsin otomatis mengonsumsi Edict dalam 3 dtk berikutnya untuk memicu efek berikut maksimal sekali per detik. Memicu ulang efek akan me-reset durasi:
- Saat Edict dikonsumsi, memanggil Soaring Pillar dari Manifold Sanctum sebagai Coordinated Attack untuk menyerang target satu kali, memberikan Electro DMG.
- Edict dapat dikonsumsi otomatis hingga 1 stack per detik.
- Damage yang diberikan Soaring Pillar tidak memicu efek ini.
- Saat Hsin tumbang, semua stack Edict dihapus.

Heart Manifest

Meningkatkan ketahanan Hsin terhadap interupsi selama 45 dtk.
Memasuki state Heart Manifest me-reset Illumining Form Hsin.
Saat dalam state Heart Manifest dan Illumining Form, jika Pillars Across Heaven terkunci, tekan Resonance Liberation agar Hsin melancarkan Invoked Form: Answering. Saat dalam Answering Form, tekan Resonance Liberation agar Hsin melancarkan Invoked Form: Illumining.
Selain itu, jika Hsin masih dalam Illumining Form setelah keluar dari Heart Manifest, dan Pillars Across Heaven terkunci, tekan Resonance Liberation agar Hsin melancarkan Invoked Form: Answering.

Invoked Form: Answering

Hsin kembali sementara ke Answering Form. Saat skill ini dilancarkan, jika Hsin berada di tanah, ia melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 2; jika berada di udara, ia melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

Invoked Form: Illumining

Hsin kembali ke Illumining Form. Saat skill ini dilancarkan, jika Hsin berada di tanah, ia melancarkan Upward Cut - Illumining Form; jika berada di udara, ia melancarkan Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.

description.en:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, when Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, Her ATK is increased by 50% for 8s. Switching to another Resonator or Resonance Mode ends this effect.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare, Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
description.id:
Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison, ketika Hsin melancarkan Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison atau Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, ATK-nya meningkat sebesar 50% selama 8 dtk. Berganti ke Resonator lain atau Resonance Mode mengakhiri efek ini.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, setelah Resonator tim menimbulkan Electro Flare, Hsin mendapat 25% Electro DMG Bonus, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali. Setiap Resonator hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali. Selain itu, jika Rover: Electro berada di tim yang sama, saat Rover: Electro melancarkan Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Hsin dan Rover: Electro sama-sama mendapat 20% Electro DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk.
Efek ini di-reset saat Resonator ditambahkan ke tim atau saat Hsin berganti Resonance Mode.

description.en:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, the maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare and Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict Electro Flare on a target, every 1 stack of Electro Flare inflicted grants Hisn 1 stack of Thunderglow, stacking up to 10 times.
While Hsin is in the Heart Manifest state, when targets within a certain range have 0 stacks of Electro Flare, inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the targets. If Thunderglow on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the target, She also inflicts Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- When Fleeting Thunder is active, if the maximum stacks of Electro Flare on the target is increased, Hsin will inflict Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- Fleeting Thunder will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the Heart Manifest state or switching Resonance Mode removes the aforementioned effects.
description.id:
Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison, stack maksimum efek Unison Boon pada Resonator tim meningkat sebesar 1. Saat Resonator tim memicu Unison Response, seluruh Resonator tim mendapat 1 stack Unison Boon selama 30 dtk. Efek ini tidak bertumpuk.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare dan Hsin tidak dalam state Heart Manifest, setelah Resonator tim selain Hsin menimbulkan Electro Flare pada target, setiap 1 stack Electro Flare yang ditimbulkan memberikan Hsin 1 stack Thunderglow, bertumpuk hingga 10 kali.
Saat Hsin dalam state Heart Manifest, ketika target dalam jangkauan tertentu memiliki 0 stack Electro Flare, timbulkan 1 stack Electro Flare pada target. Jika Thunderglow pada Hsin mencapai batas stack, Hsin juga menimbulkan Fleeting Thunder pada target:
- Saat Hsin menimbulkan Fleeting Thunder pada target, ia juga menimbulkan Electro Flare pada target hingga batas stack, maksimal 16 stack Electro Flare.
- Saat Fleeting Thunder aktif, jika stack maksimum Electro Flare pada target meningkat, Hsin akan menimbulkan Electro Flare pada target hingga batas stack lagi, maksimal 16 stack Electro Flare.
- Fleeting Thunder akan dihapus saat target meninggalkan jangkauan tertentu di sekitar Hsin.
Keluar dari state Heart Manifest atau berganti Resonance Mode menghapus efek-efek di atas.

description.en:
Intro Skill - Answering Form

This skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3 (when in Resonance Mode - Unison) or Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4 (when in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare).

Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison

This skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

Intro Skill - Illumining Form

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.

Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 3 (saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison) atau Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 4 (saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare).

Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison

Skill ini tersedia saat dalam Answering Form. Menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG yang lebih besar, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Setelah melancarkan skill ini, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu singkat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Answering Form Tahap 3.

Intro Skill - Illumining Form

Skill ini tersedia saat dalam Illumining Form. Menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison

Skill ini tersedia saat dalam Illumining Form. Menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG yang lebih besar, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

description.en:
Forms Born of Heart

While in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer

While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Mechanism Dominion

The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison

While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
While casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder.
When Hsin has at least 50 stacks of Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned inflict Electro Flare on hit targets, up to 5 times. Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the target hit. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the target hit.

Unison

While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison with Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's Unison to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and Unison at the same time, only Unison is consumed to trigger the effect.

Unison Response

While Hsin is in Resonance Mode - Unison and the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Hsin triggers Unison Response after She is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting 1 stack of Unison Boon to all Resonators in the team for 30s.
Hsin can only grant up to 1 stack of Unison Boon in this way.

Unison Boon

Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger Unison Response in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

Answering Heart

Can hold up to 100 points of Answering Heart.
While in Answering Form, when Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison hits a target, Hsin gains Answering Heart if She is the active Resonator.
Casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison grants 60 points of Answering Heart.

Illumining Heart

Can hold up to 300 points of Illumining Heart.
While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, when Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, or Intro Skill - Illumining Form hits a target, Hsin gains Illumining Heart if She is the active Resonator.
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison directly sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state and grants 300 points of Illumining Heart.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift, when the Modular Heartlock generated by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 is collapsed by Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, additionally gain 150 points of Illumining Heart if Hsin is the active Resonator in Illumining Form but not in the Mechanism Dominion state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.
description.id:
Forms Born of Heart

Saat dalam Answering Form, Hsin dapat memperoleh dan mengonsumsi Answering Heart.
Saat dalam Illumining Form, Hsin dapat memperoleh dan mengonsumsi Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer

Saat dalam Answering Form, ketika Answering Heart Hsin mencapai 100 poin, Heavy Attack - Answering Form digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan skill dengan mengonsumsi STA dan 100 poin Answering Heart. Hsin kebal terhadap interupsi selama aksi, dan memberikan Electro DMG kepada target, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer memberikan Hsin Resolution of Wishes. Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer ini mengonsumsi Resolution of Wishes untuk menjadi Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, memberikan DMG yang lebih besar. Resolution of Wishes hanya dapat diperoleh sekali setiap 24 dtk.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer atau Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, jika Hsin tidak dalam state Heart Manifest, buka Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons

Saat dalam Illumining Form, ketika Illumining Heart Hsin mencapai 0 selama state Mechanism Dominion, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Tahan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan skill dengan mengonsumsi STA, memberikan Electro DMG kepada target, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons memberikan Hsin Law of Heaven. Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons ini mengonsumsi Law of Heaven untuk menjadi Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, memberikan DMG yang lebih besar. Law of Heaven hanya dapat diperoleh sekali setiap 24 dtk.
Melancarkan Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons atau Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons mengakhiri state Mechanism Dominion dan membuka Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

Saat dalam Illumining Form, ketika Illumining Heart Hsin mencapai 300 poin dan ia berada di tanah, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
Saat Hsin berada di tanah, tekan Resonance Skill untuk memberikan Electro DMG kepada target di sekitar.
Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned membuat Hsin memasuki state Mechanism Dominion.

Mechanism Dominion

State Mechanism Dominion bertahan selama 13 dtk.
Selama state ini aktif, Basic Attack - Illumining Form digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, dan Dodge Counter - Illumining Form digantikan oleh Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
Saat Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned atau Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned mengenai target, Illumining Heart dikonsumsi jika Hsin adalah Resonator aktif.
Keluar dari Mechanism Dominion menghapus Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin mendapat efek berikut:
- Hsin dapat memicu Unison Response, tetapi tidak di Co-op Mode.
- Setelah melancarkan Intro Skill - Answering Form atau Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, Resonance Liberation - Formshift berikutnya memberikan Hsin Unison selama 5 dtk.
- Saat Hsin memicu Unison Response, ia mendapat Source Intent, dan Intro Skill kali ini digantikan oleh Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, memberikan DMG yang lebih besar.
Saat Hsin melancarkan Intro Skill tanpa memicu Unison Response sambil memiliki Source Intent, ia mengonsumsi Source Intent sebagai gantinya, dan Intro Skill digantikan oleh Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, memberikan DMG yang lebih besar.
- Efek-efek di atas dihapus saat Hsin berganti Resonance Mode.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill - Illumining Form atau Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison langsung membuat Hsin memasuki state Mechanism Dominion.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin mendapat efek berikut:
- Saat Hsin memasuki pertempuran, target dalam jangkauan tertentu tidak kehilangan stack Electro Flare saat dipicu.
- Setelah Resonator tim menimbulkan Electro Rage pada target, setiap 1 stack Electro Rage yang ditimbulkan memberikan Hsin 1 stack Heart of Thunder, bertumpuk hingga 100 kali, dan mengonsumsi seluruh stack Electro Rage dari target tersebut. Heart of Thunder dihapus saat Hsin berganti Resonance Mode.
- Pada tahap terakhir Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin secara aktif memicu 1 kali Electro Flare DMG pada target. Pengali DMG-nya sama dengan 35% x (jumlah stack Heart of Thunder pada Hsin) x (pengali Electro Flare DMG yang sesuai dengan stack Electro Flare target saat ini).
Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, berganti ke Resonator lain atau mengakhiri skill lebih awal menghapus efek-efek di atas.
Beberapa saat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin mengonsumsi seluruh sisa stack Heart of Thunder.
Saat Hsin memiliki setidaknya 50 stack Heart of Thunder, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form membuat target di sekitar mengalami Stagnation selama aksi.
- Setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Formshift, timbulkan 5 stack Electro Flare pada target di sekitar dalam jangkauan tertentu. Ini juga membuat Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned atau Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned menimbulkan Electro Flare pada target yang terkena, hingga 5 kali. Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Formshift lagi me-reset hitungan ini. Berganti Resonance Mode menghapusnya.
Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned dan Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons menimbulkan 5 stack Electro Flare pada target yang terkena. Intro Skill - Illumining Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, dan Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector menimbulkan 1 stack Electro Flare pada target yang terkena.

Unison

Saat Hsin dalam Resonance Mode - Unison dengan Unison, berganti ke Resonator lain akan menghapus Unison Hsin untuk memicu Outro Skill Hsin dan Intro Skill Resonator yang masuk. Jika Hsin memiliki Concerto Energy penuh dan Unison secara bersamaan, hanya Unison yang dikonsumsi untuk memicu efek.

Unison Response

Saat Hsin dalam Resonance Mode - Unison dan Resonator aktif di tim memiliki Unison, Hsin memicu Unison Response setelah ia diganti masuk dan melancarkan Intro Skill, memberikan 1 stack Unison Boon kepada seluruh Resonator tim selama 30 dtk.
Hsin hanya dapat memberikan hingga 1 stack Unison Boon dengan cara ini.

Unison Boon

Hanya Resonator yang dapat memicu Unison Response yang bisa mendapat efek ini. Setiap stack Unison Boon meningkatkan total DMG yang diberikan Resonator tim yang dapat memicu Unison Response sebesar 3%, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.

Answering Heart

Dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Answering Heart.
Saat dalam Answering Form, ketika Normal Attack - Answering Form, Resonance Skill - Answering Form, Intro Skill - Answering Form, atau Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison mengenai target, Hsin mendapat Answering Heart jika ia adalah Resonator aktif.
Melancarkan Intro Skill - Answering Form atau Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison memberikan 60 poin Answering Heart.

Illumining Heart

Dapat menyimpan hingga 300 poin Illumining Heart.
Saat dalam Illumining Form dan tidak dalam state Mechanism Dominion, ketika Normal Attack - Illumining Form, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, atau Intro Skill - Illumining Form mengenai target, Hsin mendapat Illumining Heart jika ia adalah Resonator aktif.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison, melancarkan Intro Skill - Illumining Form atau Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison langsung membuat Hsin memasuki state Mechanism Dominion dan memberikan 300 poin Illumining Heart.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, setelah melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Formshift, ketika Modular Heartlock yang dihasilkan Basic Attack - Illumining Form Tahap 1 diruntuhkan oleh Basic Attack - Illumining Form Tahap 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, atau Resonance Skill - Illumining Form, dapatkan tambahan 150 poin Illumining Heart jika Hsin adalah Resonator aktif dalam Illumining Form tetapi tidak dalam state Mechanism Dominion. Efek ini hanya dapat dipicu sekali sebelum pelancaran Resonance Liberation - Formshift berikutnya me-reset-nya, dan dinonaktifkan saat berganti ke Resonance Mode lain.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 100% of Hsin's ATK.
Hsin gains Nightglow upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven. When Hsin casts Outro Skill, Nightglow is consumed to trigger various effects depending on the Resonance Mode She is in:
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain Shared Light when they gain Unison. After Hsin casts Outro Skill, Resonators with Shared Light gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain 20% Electro DMG Amplification for 20s.
The above effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG sebesar 100% ATK Hsin.
Hsin mendapat Nightglow saat memasuki pertempuran atau melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven. Saat Hsin melancarkan Outro Skill, Nightglow dikonsumsi untuk memicu berbagai efek tergantung Resonance Mode yang sedang aktif:
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonator tim selain Hsin mendapat Shared Light saat mereka mendapat Unison. Setelah Hsin melancarkan Outro Skill, Resonator dengan Shared Light mendapat 20% All DMG Amplify selama 30 dtk.
- Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Resonator tim selain Hsin mendapat 20% Electro DMG Amplify selama 20 dtk.
Efek-efek di atas berakhir lebih awal saat Hsin berganti Resonance Mode.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

sequences.name: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide

description.en:
Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin 2 stacks of Radiance Ward, stacking up to 2 times. Switching to Answering Form clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of Radiance Ward can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison are increased by 15%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison by 10%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When Hsin enters combat, if Heart of Thunder is below 50 stacks, it is increased to 50 stacks, triggered once every 12s.
The DMG Multiplier of the Electro Flare DMG triggered by Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon is increased to 42% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks on Hsin) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).
description.id:
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation - Formshift memberikan Hsin 2 stack Radiance Ward, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali. Berganti ke Answering Form menghapus semua stack. Saat Hsin menerima DMG dari serangan target musuh, 1 stack Radiance Ward dapat dikonsumsi untuk membuatnya kebal terhadap interupsi dan mengurangi DMG yang diterima sebesar 60% selama 1 dtk. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 1 dtk.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison:
Pengali DMG Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison dan Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison meningkat sebesar 15%, dan setiap stack Unison Boon meningkatkan tambahan pengali DMG Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison dan Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sebesar 10%, hingga total 4 stack.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
Saat Hsin memasuki pertempuran, jika Heart of Thunder di bawah 50 stack, jumlahnya naik menjadi 50 stack, aktif sekali setiap 12 dtk.
Pengali DMG Electro Flare DMG yang dipicu oleh Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon meningkat menjadi 42% x (jumlah stack Heart of Thunder pada Hsin) x (pengali Electro Flare DMG yang sesuai dengan stack Electro Flare target saat ini).

sequences.name: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am

description.en:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector are increased by 60%.
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons and Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons are increased by 60%.

When Hsin enters combat, reset the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain Resolution of Wishes and Law of Heaven, and restore 100 additional points of Answering Heart. This effect can be triggered once every 12s.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer dan Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector meningkat sebesar 60%.
Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons dan Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons meningkat sebesar 60%.

Saat Hsin memasuki pertempuran, reset Cooldown perolehan Resolution of Wishes dan Law of Heaven oleh Hsin, dan pulihkan tambahan 100 poin Answering Heart. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 12 dtk.

sequences.name: A Dream of Return Among the Hills

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 70%.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 20%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases its Crit. DMG by 15%, up to a total of 4 stacks.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When the last stage of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven hits a target inflicted with Electro Flare, it triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 1500% times the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current Electro Flare stacks on the target.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven meningkat sebesar 70%.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison:
Crit. DMG Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven meningkat sebesar 20%, dan setiap stack Unison Boon meningkatkan tambahan Crit. DMG-nya sebesar 15%, hingga total 4 stack.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
Saat tahap terakhir Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven mengenai target yang terkena Electro Flare, skill ini memicu 1 kali Electro Flare DMG, dengan pengali DMG sama dengan 1500% dikali pengali Electro Flare DMG yang sesuai dengan stack Electro Flare target saat ini.

sequences.name: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes

description.en:
All Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s when a Resonator in the team triggers any of the following actions:
- Inflict Electro Flare or Electro Rage on a target.
- Gain Unison while not having the effect.
- Trigger Unison Response.
description.id:
Seluruh Resonator tim mendapat 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk saat Resonator tim memicu salah satu aksi berikut:
- Menimbulkan Electro Flare atau Electro Rage pada target.
- Mendapat Unison saat tidak memiliki efeknya.
- Memicu Unison Response.

sequences.name: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills

description.en:
While in Illumining Form, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by 20%.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores 100% of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute.
description.id:
Saat dalam Illumining Form, DMG yang diterima Hsin berkurang sebesar 20%.
Saat Hsin menerima serangan fatal, ia tidak akan tumbang, melainkan memulihkan 100% Max HP dan kebal terhadap DMG dan interupsi selama 1 dtk. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 10 menit.

sequences.name: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living

description.en:
Targets take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are additionally increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team additionally gain 1 stack of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
While in combat, Electro Flare DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at 80% and Crit. DMG fixed at 230%.
description.id:
Target menerima 40% lebih banyak Resonance Skill DMG dari Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG yang diberikan Hsin mengabaikan 20% DEF target.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Unison:
Stack maksimum efek Unison Boon pada Resonator tim meningkat tambahan sebesar 1. Saat Resonator tim memicu Unison Response, seluruh Resonator tim juga mendapat tambahan 1 stack Unison Boon selama 30 dtk. Efek ini tidak bertumpuk.

Saat dalam Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
Saat dalam pertempuran, Electro Flare DMG yang diterima target dalam jangkauan tertentu di sekitar Hsin dapat menjadi Critical, dengan Crit. Rate tetap 80% dan Crit. DMG tetap 230%.
